info.title: Odds API v5
info.description: High-performance odds API backed by Valkey + Supabase RPC discovery.

get.description:
List bookmakers.

Returns the bookmaker catalog available to the provided apiKey.

Lookup mode: `bookmakers` (optional filter list) + `playerProps` (optional capability filter).

parameters.name: bookmakers
parameters.description: Comma- or space-separated bookmaker slugs. Supports `*` / `all` for wildcard.

parameters.name: playerProps
parameters.description: If true, only return bookmakers that support player proposition markets.

get.description:
List sports.

Lookup mode: `sportIds` (optional filter list).

List tournaments.

Lookup mode: `sportId` OR `tournamentIds`.

Default: if neither is provided, the API uses `sportId=11`.

List seasons.

Lookup mode: `seasonIds` OR `tournamentId`.

List participants.

Lookup mode: `participantIds` OR `sportId` OR `playerId`.

List players.

Lookup mode: `playerIds` OR `participantId` OR `sportId`.

Name fields are returned in the requested language when available.

List markets.

Lookup mode: `marketIds` OR `sportId` OR `outcomeIds`.

List currencies and conversion values.

Lookup mode: `currency` (optional filter).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code (case-insensitive), e.g. EUR, usd, BTC.

get.description:
List fixtures.

Lookup mode: `fixtureIds` OR filters (`sportId`, `tournamentId`, `statusId`, optional time range).

If `bookmakers` is present, bookmaker meta is included and results may be filtered by mapping availability.

parameters.name: bookmakers
parameters.description: Comma/space-separated bookmaker slugs. If present (even empty), includes bookmaker META and filters by mapping.

parameters.name: oddsIds

get.description:
Get current main odds for multiple fixtures.

Lookup mode: provide exactly one of:
- `tournamentId` (recommended)
- `fixtureIds` (fast path)

If `since` is provided, returns odds updates with `changedAt >= since`.

**Capped at 100 fixtures per call.** The limit is fixed and cannot be raised by a parameter — `limit`, `offset`, `cursor` and `page` are not supported and are ignored if sent. Truncation is silent: a `tournamentId` with more than 100 fixtures, or a `fixtureIds` list longer than 100, still returns `200` with only the first 100 entries and no warning. To cover a larger tournament, list the fixtures first with `/fixtures?tournamentId=...` (uncapped) and then request odds in chunks of 100 via `fixtureIds`.

Response size is driven by the number of **bookmakers**, not the number of fixtures. A single top-league call with `bookmakers=*` can return tens of MiB and take ten seconds, while the same call narrowed to one bookmaker returns well under a MiB in under a second. Always pass an explicit `bookmakers` list in production.

parameters.name: tournamentId
parameters.description: Single tournamentId. Required if `fixtureIds` is not provided. Only the first 100 fixtures of the tournament are returned; see the endpoint description for chunking.

parameters.name: fixtureIds
parameters.description: Comma/space-separated fixtureIds (fast path). Required if `tournamentId` is not provided. Maximum 100 ids — anything beyond the first 100 is silently dropped.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: changedAt >= since (ms). If provided, returns also inactive odds.

200.description: Returns an array of fixtures (fixture meta + odds + bookmaker meta).

example.summary: Odds by tournament (fixtures list with odds)

get.description:
Price a parlay (accumulator) from selected `oddsIds`.

The legs are grouped by bookmaker and each group's prices are multiplied locally — no bookmaker round-trip and **no correlation adjustment**. Legs may span several fixtures and sports; for a correlated same-game price use `/fixtures/odds/sgp`.

Returns one normal fixture view per fixture a leg belongs to, ordered by `fixtureId`, each with a `parlay` section added. A cross-fixture parlay appears on every involved fixture with the same entry.

Max 20 legs per request.

200.description: One FixtureParlayResponse per involved fixture, ordered by fixtureId.

priced.summary: Two legs, one bookmaker, both live
priced.description: `price` is the product of 3.8 x 2.1. On this endpoint `singlesPrice` always equals `price` while the parlay is active.

compare_bookmakers.summary: Same two legs at two bookmakers
compare_bookmakers.description: Request the same selections at several bookmakers and each one is priced as its own parlay, side by side under its own `parlayId`.

multi_fixture.description: The parlay spans an NFL and an NBA fixture. It is returned on BOTH fixtures with the same `parlayId` and the same entry; each fixture's `odds` section holds only its own leg.

leg_suspended.summary: A leg exists but is currently OFF
leg_suspended.description: The leg is still returned in `odds` with `active: false`, and the parlay keeps an entry: inactive, `price: 1` (stake back), `meta.inactiveReason` naming the cause, and `singlesPrice` still showing what it would have paid.

leg_missing.summary: A leg could not be found
leg_missing.description: Unknown bookmaker, or an unknown/expired oddsId. Pricing half a parlay would be meaningless, so the bookmaker gets NO entry and `parlay` comes back `{}` — `missingOddsIds` names the legs that were not found.

get.description:
Price a correlated same-game parlay (SGP) from selected `oddsIds`.

All `oddsIds` must belong to **one** fixture. The legs are priced by the bookmaker itself, so `price` reflects the correlation between them; `singlesPrice` is the naive product and the gap is the correlation margin. Several bookmakers may be requested at once and are returned side by side.

Returns ONE fixture view with an `sgp` section added.

Max 20 legs per request.

parameters.name: oddsIds
parameters.description: Comma- or space-separated oddsIds in the form `{fixtureId}:{bookmaker}:{outcomeId}:{playerId}`. Duplicates are removed and the list is sorted. Each bookmaker's legs form one parlay. Max 20 legs. All must share one fixture.

200.description: One FixtureSgpResponse for the fixture the legs belong to.

priced.summary: Two correlated legs, quoted by the bookmaker
priced.description: `singlesPrice` 7.98 is what the naive product would pay; the bookmaker's correlated `price` is 6.5. `limit` is the max stake and `betslip` opens the wager pre-filled.

not_priceable.summary: Legs found, but the bookmaker will not price them
not_priceable.description: The legs exist, so they keep an entry: inactive, `price: 1`, and `meta.inactiveReason` saying why (`not_combinable`, `sgp_unsupported`, `sgp_fetch_failed`, `fixture_ended`, `leg_suspended`, `market_closed`, `bookmaker_suspended`). `not_combinable` — the book will not combine these particular legs — is the most common in practice.

leg_missing.summary: A leg could not be found
leg_missing.description: The bookmaker gets NO entry — `sgp` comes back `{}` and `missingOddsIds` names the legs that were not found.

get.description:
List futures.

Lookup mode: `futureIds` OR `sportId` OR `tournamentId` (at least one).

parameters.name: bookmakers
parameters.description: If provided, includes bookmakers meta per future AND filters by mapping. Note: no future currently carries a bookmaker mapping, so passing any value — including `*` or empty — returns an empty result set.

get.description:
List live futures.

Lookup mode: optional `sportId` / `tournamentId` filters.

Get latest odds for a future.

Lookup mode: required `futureId` + optional filters (`bookmakers`, `since`, `mainLines`, `includeFuture`).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: changedAt >= since (ms). Consistent with fixtures: all odds-update times are epoch milliseconds.

parameters.name: includeFuture
parameters.description: If true, includes futureMeta in the response.

loc.title: Location

Error.description: Concrete error format returned by this API (no FastAPI detail wrapper).

details.description: Optional extra details (string/object/array depending on the error).

slug.description: Stable bookmaker slug — the key used in `bookmakers` filters and in all odds payloads.

active.description: Whether the bookmaker is currently served by the API.

domain.description: Main public website URL of the bookmaker.

serverGroup.description: Deprecated internal field — safe to ignore for API consumers.

price.description: Deprecated internal field — safe to ignore for API consumers.

websocketPregame.description: Whether pregame odds for this bookmaker are streamed over the WebSocket.

websocketLive.description: Whether live (in-play) odds for this bookmaker are streamed over the WebSocket.

playerProps.description: Whether this bookmaker offers player proposition markets.

maxDelayPregameInSec.description: Maximum expected refresh delay for pregame odds, in seconds — the freshness bound for this bookmaker. Measured from observed vs. bookmaker change times (currently the rolling p50) where the book publishes usable timestamps, estimated otherwise.

maxDelayLiveInSec.description: Maximum expected refresh delay for live odds, in seconds. Measured from observed vs. bookmaker change times (currently the rolling p50) where the book publishes usable timestamps, estimated otherwise.

maxDelayPregameMainInSec.description: Maximum expected refresh delay for pregame main lines, in seconds. Measured from observed vs. bookmaker change times (currently the rolling p50) where the book publishes usable timestamps, estimated otherwise.

availableCountries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the bookmaker accepts customers.

sportId.description: Numeric sport identifier. Also the first two digits of downstream `marketId`, `outcomeId` and `fixtureId` values.

slug.description: URL-safe sport slug. This field will be renamed to `sportSlug` in a future release.

sportName.description: Sport display name, translated per the request language prefix.

tournamentId.description: Numeric tournament identifier (embedded zero-padded to 6 digits inside fixture/future IDs).

categorySlug.description: URL-safe slug of the category (usually the country/region) the tournament belongs to.

tournamentName.description: Tournament display name, translated per the request language prefix.

categoryName.description: Category display name, translated per the request language prefix.

seasonName.description: Season display name, translated per the request language prefix.

name.description: Full participant name, translated per the request language prefix. This field will be renamed to `participantName` in a future release.

playerId.description: Numeric player identifier. `0` is reserved to mean "no player" in odds and settlement payloads.

outcomeId.description: Frozen outcome identifier — a fully decomposed selection (marketType → period → handicap → side). First two digits = `sportId`.

outcomeName.description: Outcome display name, translated per the request language prefix.

marketId.description: Frozen market identifier — equal to the first (lowest) `outcomeId` of the market.

sportId.description: Sport the market belongs to (also the first two digits of `marketId`).

marketType.description: Open market-type taxonomy value (e.g. `1x2`, `totals`, `spreads`, `players-shots`). Stable per value, never exhaustive.

period.description: Generic period key the market settles on (see the period vocabulary in Enumerations).

marketLength.description: Number of outcomes under this marketId - the sides that can be bet on, together forming the complete probability space (implied probabilities sum to ~1 before margin removal).

playerProp.description: True for player proposition markets — their odds rows carry a non-zero `playerId`.

handicap.description: Handicap / total line of the market. Each line is its own market (own `marketId`).

marketName.description: Market display name, translated per the request language prefix.

outcomes.description: The market's outcomes, in their canonical order.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest rate refresh.

currencyValue.description: Current exchange rate for the currency.

venueName.description: Venue display name, translated per the request language prefix.

venueLocation.description: Venue location (city), translated per the request language prefix.

live.description: Convenience flag — true only while in play (`statusId` 1).

statusId.description: Lifecycle status: `0` pregame, `1` live, `2` finished, `3` cancelled. Moves forward only — always branch on this ID.

statusName.description: Translated display label for the status. For logic, branch on `statusId`, never on this string.

sportName.description: Sport display name, translated per the request language prefix.

tournamentName.description: Tournament display name, translated per the request language prefix.

seasonRound.description: Round number within the season, when applicable.

currentPeriod.description: Period key currently being played (see the period vocabulary in Enumerations).

remainingTimeInPeriod.description: Remaining time in the current period, `mm:ss`.

stopped.description: True while the match clock is stopped.

participant1RotNr.description: Rotation number of participant 1 (US-book convention), when available.

participant2RotNr.description: Rotation number of participant 2 (US-book convention), when available.

period.description: Period key this score row refers to (`result` = overall scoreline; see Enumerations).

participant1Score.description: Score of participant 1 for this period.

participant2Score.description: Score of participant 2 for this period.

updatedAt.description: When this score value last changed.

bookmakerFixtureId.description: Native fixture identifier at the bookmaker.

fixturePath.description: Path of the fixture page on the bookmaker's site, when known.

hasOdds.description: True if the bookmaker currently publishes odds for this fixture.

staleOdds.description: Critical for trading: true if the connection to this bookmaker was lost or interrupted, so odds freshness can no longer be guaranteed.

staleOddsResponseCode.description: **Deprecated.** HTTP status code observed during the staleness check, when any. Rely on `staleOdds` instead.

suspended.description: True while the bookmaker has suspended betting on this fixture.

participantsRotated.description: True if the bookmaker lists the participants in the opposite order (participant 1/2 swapped) relative to OddsPapi.

updatedAt.description: When this bookmaker meta last changed.

fixtureId.description: Fixture identifier: `{prefix}{sportId}{tournamentId}{nativeId}` — see Core Concepts → ID structure.

reissuedFixtureId.description: The fixture that replaced this one, when a cancelled fixture has been re-listed under a new id. `null` is the normal value: it is only ever populated on a cancelled fixture (`status.statusId` `3`) whose replacement already exists in the feed, so permanent cancellations stay `null`, and a fixture can go from `null` to an id after you first saw it cancelled. One hop: if the replacement was itself cancelled, follow its own `reissuedFixtureId`.

previousFixtureId.description: The inverse of `reissuedFixtureId`: the cancelled fixture this one replaced. Unlike the forward pointer this sits on a normal scheduled or live fixture, so a fixture carries its own history even if you never saw the cancelled one. `null` is the normal value. One hop and one predecessor at most — follow it repeatedly to walk back to the start of a chain, where a fixture postponed twice gives `A → B → C` and `B` carries both `previousFixtureId: A` and `reissuedFixtureId: C`. Cleared again if a postponement is reverted.

trueStartTime.description: Actual start time (ISO 8601), once known — may differ from the scheduled `startTime`.

participants.description: Both participants with names, rotation numbers and abbreviations.

clock.description: Live match clock, while in play.

expectedPeriods.description: Number of regular periods expected for this fixture — use it (with `periodLength`) to interpret period keys per sport/league.

periodLength.description: Length of a regular period in minutes.

externalProviders.description: Native identifiers of this fixture at external providers (betradar, pinnacle, …).

bookmakers.description: Per-bookmaker availability and freshness metadata. Only populated when the `bookmakers` query parameter is present on the request — otherwise `{}`. Contains only bookmakers that currently offer valid realtime odds for this fixture. Present on odds endpoints; omitted on CLV, historical-odds and settlement responses.

outcomeId.description: Frozen outcome identifier of the selection.

playerId.description: Player the price refers to; `0` for non-player markets.

active.description: Whether this outcome is currently available at the bookmaker.

marketActive.description: Whether the entire market is active at the bookmaker. Advisory and optional — many bookmakers never report it, so `null` is common and does not mean the market is closed (as one example, every quote from `bet365` on a sampled fixture returned `null` while `pinnacle` returned `true` on all of its own). Use `active` on the quote itself as the authoritative per-row state; treat `marketActive` as extra context only.

mainLine.description: Whether this is the bookmaker's main line for the market type.

marketId.description: Frozen market identifier the outcome belongs to.

bookmakerChangedAt.description: Bookmaker-provided change timestamp (epoch ms), when present.

limit.description: Maximum accepted stake, when provided by the bookmaker.

betslip.description: Bookmaker betslip / deeplink token, when available.

changedAt.description: When OddsPapi observed this change at the bookmaker (epoch ms, UTC) — always present.

betslip.description: Bookmaker betslip / deeplink token, when available.

changedAt.description: When OddsPapi observed this price point at the bookmaker (epoch ms, UTC).

olv.description: Opening line value — the earliest recorded price point for the outcome.

clv.description: Closing line value — the last recorded price point before the fixture started. `null` until the fixture closes, so every quote on a pre-game fixture returns `clv: null` with only `olv` populated.

bookmakerFixtureId.description: Native fixture identifier at the bookmaker.

participantsRotated.description: True if the bookmaker lists the participants in the opposite order (participant 1/2 swapped).

marketId.description: Frozen market identifier the settlement refers to.

marketType.description: Market-type taxonomy value of the settled market.

playerId.description: Player the settlement refers to; `0` for non-player markets.

margin.description: Winning margin used for grading, when applicable.

team1Score.description: Final score of participant 1 used for grading.

team2Score.description: Final score of participant 2 used for grading.

periods.description: Per-period scores used to grade period markets.

marketId.description: Future market identifier (e.g. `1` = Winner). Future markets are a separate namespace from `/markets`, so this id cannot be resolved through that endpoint.

marketName.description: Future market display name, translated. Not currently populated in production — returns `null`.

marketType.description: Market-type taxonomy value (e.g. `outrights`). Not currently populated in production — returns `null`.

bookmakerFutureId.description: Native future/outright identifier at the bookmaker.

participantsRotated.description: True if the bookmaker lists selections in a different order relative to OddsPapi.

futureId.description: Future identifier: `{prefix}{sportId}{seasonId}{futureMarketId}` — see Core Concepts → Future IDs. Tournament is a field on the future, not a segment of this ID.

reissuedFutureId.description: The future that replaced this one, when a cancelled future has been re-listed under a new id. `null` is the normal value: it is only ever populated on a cancelled future (`status.statusId` `3`) whose replacement already exists in the feed, so permanent cancellations stay `null`, and a future can go from `null` to an id after you first saw it cancelled. One hop: if the replacement was itself cancelled, follow its own `reissuedFutureId`.

previousFutureId.description: The inverse of `reissuedFutureId`: the cancelled future this one replaced. Unlike the forward pointer this sits on a normal open future, so a future carries its own history even if you never saw the cancelled one. `null` is the normal value. One hop and one predecessor at most — follow it repeatedly to walk back to the start of a chain. Cleared again if a cancellation is reverted.

participants.description: Participants attached to this future. Not currently populated in production — every future returns `[]` (0 of 2,018 sampled across 40 sports carried any participant), so resolve names via `/participants` or the tournament/season metadata instead.

externalProviders.description: Native identifiers of this future at external providers (polymarket, kalshi, …).

bookmakers.description: Per-bookmaker metadata for this future. Contains only bookmakers that currently offer valid realtime odds (empty object when none do).

FutureOddsRow.description: A single futures odds entry. The key for futures odds is futureId:bookmaker:futureOutcomeId:participantId.

oddsId.description: Stable identifier of this odds row. Format: `{futureId}:{bookmaker}:{futureOutcomeId}:{participantId}`. Treat this value as an opaque string and read individual values from the explicit fields on this row rather than splitting it.

futureOutcomeId.description: Side and line within the future market. Participant-keyed markets (winner, topscorer, relegation, mvp) own no outcome rows and carry the sentinel `0` — the selection is the participant. Decomposed markets (Yes/No, Over/Under) carry a real 6-digit id (>= 100001) per side per line; the handicap sits on the outcome, not on the market. Never overlaps the futureMarketId space, which is at most 5 digits.

participantId.description: Participant the outright price refers to, when the selection maps to a participant.

active.description: Whether this selection is currently available at the bookmaker.

bookmakerChangedAt.description: Bookmaker-provided change timestamp (epoch ms), when present.

limit.description: Maximum accepted stake, when provided by the bookmaker.

betslip.description: Bookmaker betslip / deeplink token, when available.

changedAt.description: When OddsPapi observed this change at the bookmaker (epoch ms, UTC) — always present.

odds.description: Odds rows of this bookmaker for the future.

futureId.description: Future identifier the odds belong to.

futureMeta.description: Future metadata echoed with the odds.

bookmakerFutureId.description: Native future/outright identifier at the bookmaker.

participantsRotated.description: True if the bookmaker lists selections in a different order relative to OddsPapi.

ParlayEntry.description: One bookmaker's price for one parlay. Produced locally by multiplying the leg prices — no correlation adjustment.

active.description: False when a leg is suspended, its market is closed, or the bookmaker is suspended for an involved fixture.

price.description: Decimal product of the leg prices, 3 dp. `1` when the parlay is not bettable (stake back).

singlesPrice.description: The naive product of the legs. Equals `price` on `/fixtures/odds/parlay`; on `/fixtures/odds/sgp` the gap between the two is the correlation margin.

changedAt.description: When this entry was priced, UTC epoch milliseconds.

meta.description: Present when there is something to report.

SgpEntry.description: A bookmaker-quoted, correlation-aware parlay price. Same shape as ParlayEntry plus the fields the bookmaker returns with its quote.

active.description: False when a leg is suspended, its market is closed, or the bookmaker is suspended for an involved fixture.

price.description: The bookmaker's correlated price — usually below `singlesPrice`; the gap is the correlation margin.

singlesPrice.description: The naive product of the legs. Equals `price` on `/fixtures/odds/parlay`; on `/fixtures/odds/sgp` the gap between the two is the correlation margin.

changedAt.description: When this entry was priced, UTC epoch milliseconds.

limit.description: Max stake the bookmaker accepts at this price.

bookmakerParlayId.description: The bookmaker's own identifier for this parlay.

bookmakerChangedAt.description: The bookmaker's own quote timestamp, UTC epoch milliseconds.

betslip.description: Deep link that opens the bookmaker's betslip with every leg loaded.

meta.description: Present when there is something to report.

inactiveReason.description: Why `active` is false. Adds three SGP-only reasons to the `/fixtures/odds/parlay` set.

offers.description: An exchange's remaining price-ladder rungs below the best one, which `price`/`limit` already hold.

ParlayByBookmaker.description: bookmakerSlug -> (parlayId -> ParlayEntry). `parlayId` is the sorted, deduped oddsIds joined by `,`. A bookmaker whose legs could not all be found is omitted entirely, so this object can be `{}`.

SgpByBookmaker.description: bookmakerSlug -> (parlayId -> SgpEntry). `parlayId` is built exactly as on `/fixtures/odds/parlay`, so the two are directly comparable. A bookmaker is omitted — leaving `{}` — when its legs were not all found, or when they were but its own pricing service could not quote the parlay (in which case there is no `missingOddsIds`).

odds.description: The requested legs of this fixture and nothing else — inactive ones included (no `activeOnly` filtering). Identical in shape and content to what `/fixtures/odds` returns for those rows.

bookmakers.description: bookmakerSlug -> BookmakerFixtureMeta, for the requested bookmakers only.

missingOddsIds.description: Requested oddsIds of this fixture that could not be found (unknown bookmaker, unknown or expired oddsId). Present only when at least one leg is missing.

odds.description: The requested legs and nothing else — inactive ones included (no `activeOnly` filtering).

bookmakers.description: bookmakerSlug -> BookmakerFixtureMeta, for the requested bookmakers only.

missingOddsIds.description: Requested oddsIds of this fixture that could not be found (unknown bookmaker, unknown or expired oddsId). Present only when at least one leg is missing.
